settings.headline:
A space that

settings.intro: Kitchens, bedrooms and cabinetry designed, made and fitted by one team. Thoughtful details, made around your home.
settings.story:
From the first conversation.
To the last considered detail.
settings.name: CNK Designs
settings.address: 26 Mountview Road, Ballynahinch, Co. Down, BT24 8JR

services.title: Bespoke Kitchens
services.short: A kitchen designed for the way you live.
services.body: From a blank canvas or your own ideas, CNK Designs creates a kitchen around your space, style and budget. The team designs, manufactures and installs each commission, including cabinetry and appliance integration. Kitchens are assembled in the workshop before fitting.

services.title: Bedrooms & Wardrobes
services.short: Storage that fits your room and your routine.
services.body: CNK Designs listens to how you use your bedroom, then develops 3D elevations to plan the furniture and storage. Bespoke elements are made in the company’s workshop. Fitted wardrobes and considered corner storage feature in the portfolio.

services.title: Pantries & Utility Spaces
services.short: Make the practical spaces work beautifully.
services.body: Pantry cabinetry can be arranged around the storage and appliances you want to keep close at hand. Options illustrated in completed work include shelving, spice racks, drawers and lighting, with wood, colour and finish choices. Utility spaces can be planned alongside the kitchen.

services.title: Boot Rooms & Bespoke Joinery
services.body: The workshop also creates bespoke joinery and cabinetry for other spaces. Completed work includes a boot room with a distinctive wellie storage feature. Discuss the room, practical needs and finish with the team.

services.title: Design & Installation
services.short: One team from the first conversation to the final fitting.
services.body: CNK Designs brings consultation, 3D drawings, manufacture and installation together. Designs are made and preassembled in the Ballynahinch workshop, with appliances considered as part of the kitchen plan.

gallery.title: Brilliant White Traditional Contrast
gallery.body: Brilliant white cabinetry frames an existing red brick Aga surround. Quartz worktops, reeded glass doors and a concealed utility entrance bring practical details into a traditional setting.

gallery.title: Smoke Green Elegance
gallery.body: Smoke green cabinetry, oak interiors and antique brushed brass hardware are paired with Ivory Fossil quartz. Floor-to-ceiling storage, pantry lighting and a corner pull-out support everyday use.

gallery.title: Luxury in Natural Elements
gallery.body: Varnished oak cabinetry and brass handles create a warm kitchen with stone worktops, integrated storage and a coordinated utility room.

gallery.title: Walnut and Quartz Combination
gallery.body: In-frame walnut cabinetry is paired with Mandalay quartz, brass hardware and a concealed pantry and utility space. The island includes a bespoke area for the household’s dog bowls.

gallery.title: Bespoke Boot Room
gallery.body: A locally fitted boot room with custom cabinetry and a distinctive curved wellie storage feature.

gallery.title: Fitted Wardrobes Feature
gallery.body: Two rooms with fitted wardrobes and corner storage designed to make their contents easier to reach.

gallery.title: Pantry Gallery
gallery.body: A selection of bespoke pantry arrangements with timber interiors, drawers, spice racks and integrated space for small appliances.
